title: Less Data Approximates More: Earning Faithful Confidence in High-Stakes Domains
abstract: arXiv:2604.08454v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, where confident yet incorrect inferences may cause severe real-world harm, bringing the long-overlooked issue of confidence faithfulness to the forefront. A promising solution jointly optimizes unsupervised Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) with reasoning-trace-guided Reasoning Distillation (RD), yet it faces three persistent challenges, namely the scarcity of high-quality training corpora, factually unwarranted overconfidence, and erroneous updates amplified by indiscriminate fusion. Inspired by how human confidence accumulates from uncertainty to certainty, we propose Progressive Reasoning Gain (PRG) to measure whether reasoning steps progressively strengthen confidence in the final answer. translated_title: 少数据近似更多：在高风险领域赢得忠实置信度
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署在高风险领域，在这些领域中，自信却错误的推论可能造成严重的现实世界危害，这使得长期被忽视的置信度忠实性问题被推到了前沿。一种有前景的解决方案是将无监督的内部反馈强化学习（RLIF）与基于推理轨迹引导的推理蒸馏（RD）进行联合优化，但它面临三个持续存在的挑战，即高质量训练语料的稀缺、事实上缺乏依据的过度自信，以及不加区分的融合所放大的错误更新。受人类置信度从不确定到确定逐步累积方式的启发，我们提出了渐进式推理增益（PRG），用于衡量推理步骤是否逐步增强了对最终答案的置信度。在PRG的基础上，我们提出了HyTuning，一种混合后训练框架，它能够自适应地对RD和RLIF进行重新加权，利用稀缺的监督推理轨迹……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出渐进式推理增益（PRG）度量方法及混合后训练框架HyTuning，通过自适应地重新加权推理蒸馏与内部反馈强化学习，在监督数据稀缺的情况下，使模型在高风险领域获得忠实可信的置信度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Progressive Reasoning Gain (PRG) and HyTuning, a hybrid post-training framework that adaptively reweights reasoning distillation and internal-feedback reinforcement learning, enabling faithful model confidence in high-stakes domains despite scarce supervised reasoning data.
